<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A dialog with a walkthrough video: a title and a close button, the player area with a play button and,
  optionally, a list of chapters. Opening the dialog and playing the video are port contracts. Axes: size
  (default, wide), outline (none, chapters: a list under the player), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Chapter } from "./video-modal.types";

export type VideoModalProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  close: string;
  play: string;
  chaptersTitle: string;
  chapters: Chapter[];
  size?: "default" | "wide";
  outline?: "none" | "chapters";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  text,
  close,
  play,
  chaptersTitle,
  chapters,
  size = "default",
  outline = "none",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<VideoModalProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <Stack
      gap="4"
      align="stretch"
      :class="cn(
        'mx-auto w-full',
        (((size as string) === 'wide') ? 'max-w-4xl' : 'max-w-2xl'),
        'rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4 shadow-lg'
      )"
      role="dialog"
      :aria-label="title"
      data-testid="video-modal"
    >
      <Group gap="2" align="center" justify="between">
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ text }}
        </Text>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" type="button" class="shrink-0" :aria-label="close" data-testid="modal-close">
          <LucideIcon name="x" :size="16" />
        </Button>
      </Group>
      <Box class="relative" data-testid="player">
        <MediaFrame :alt="title" />
        <Button
          variant="default"
          size="default"
          type="button"
          class="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded"
          :aria-label="play"
          data-testid="play"
        >
          <LucideIcon name="play" :size="24" />
        </Button>
      </Box>
      <Stack
        v-if="(((outline as string) === 'chapters') && ((chapters?.length ?? 0) > 0))"
        gap="2"
        data-testid="chapters"
      >
        <Title :as="3" size="base" weight="bold">
          {{ chaptersTitle }}
        </Title>
        <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
          <ListItem v-for="c in chapters" :key="c.id" class="flex items-baseline gap-4" data-testid="item">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {{ c.title }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ c.text }}
            </Text>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
